topic.source_contract: Renewable-energy planning, solar deployment, battery storage, fire and lifecycle safety, grid connection and delivery evidence

facts.planning: solar, wind, hydropower and BESS planning considerations
facts.guard: policy support is not permission or grid connection
national deployment ambition is not a site commitment

facts.delivery: actions to accelerate solar deployment and address delivery barriers
facts.guard: roadmap actions are not project consents

facts.current: July 2026 flexibility and grid-scale battery update
facts.guard: market deployment statistics are not a site connection or energisation date

facts.safety: lifecycle health and safety guidance for grid-scale storage
facts.guard: guidance compliance is not emergency-service acceptance or planning approval

scope_guards: National renewable-energy ambition is not treated as site planning permission.
A solar or flexibility roadmap action is not treated as funded project delivery.
Land availability is not treated as grid capacity.
A connection application or queue position is not treated as an accepted offer or energisation date.
Fire-service engagement is not treated as planning approval or completed emergency plan.
Battery power, energy duration and usable capacity are not conflated.
Planning permission is not treated as construction, commissioning or commercial operation.
No score or promotion is written without exact site, consent, connection, land rights, safety acceptance, construction and operation evidence.
